name: openrouter-copilot-request-credit
displayName: OpenRouter for Copilot with Custom Request & Credit Check
description: OpenRouter provider for Copilot Chat with one control panel: paste a request body from the OpenRouter Request Builder and every chat request follows it, while the status bar tracks your key's credit usage.

openrouterCopilot.creditLimit.description: Set the local spending limit in USD. Zero disables this limit and shows the account balance; it does not change OpenRouter's server-side guardrail. Workspace overrides are ignored.

openrouterCopilot.creditResetPeriod.description: Choose when the local spending limit resets: daily, weekly, monthly, or never. Workspace overrides are ignored.

openrouterCopilot.creditIncludeByok.description: Include bring-your-own-key (BYOK) usage in the displayed usage and local spending-limit calculation. Workspace overrides are ignored.

openrouterCopilot.creditRefreshIntervalM.description: Set how often usage and credit data refresh, in minutes (1-1440). Workspace overrides are ignored.

openrouterCopilot.contextWindowPolicy.description: Choose the reported input budget for tiered-price models: Auto caps at the lower-price threshold; Full uses the model's full input budget. Workspace overrides are ignored.

openrouterCopilot.contextSafetyMarginPer.description: Changing this percentage rescales every saved numeric Custom token cap in place across all models (0-50). Auto and Full selections are unchanged. Workspace overrides are ignored.

openrouterCopilot.sanitizeBase64Content.description: Remove long base64-like strings from prompt text before sending requests. Image attachments are unchanged. Workspace overrides are ignored.
